all.source_quote: The scheme is meant for girl children
The girl child should be below 10 years of age at the time of account opening.

unmodelled.text: Account must be opened by parent or legal guardian
unmodelled.source_quote: The account can be opened in the name of a girl child by her parent or legal guardian.

unmodelled.text: Only one account per girl child
unmodelled.source_quote: Only one account can be opened in the name of one girl child.

unmodelled.text: A family can generally open accounts for a maximum of two girl children; more may be allowed in special cases
unmodelled.source_quote: A family can generally open accounts for a maximum of two girl children.

unmodelled.text: Applicant must submit birth certificate of the girl child and identity/address proof of the guardian
unmodelled.source_quote: The applicant must submit the birth certificate of the girl child and identity/address proof of the guardian.
